Among the rescued sailors stood a woman carrying his brother’s compass, still warm, its needle pointing steadily toward him.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市尚未醒透。写字楼的灯次第熄灭，便利店守着空荡的街口。环卫车缓缓驶过，水花把霓虹推成碎片；高架桥下，首班公交亮起困倦的灯。早餐铺卷起铁门，豆浆的香气漫过人行道。有人刚下夜班，有人正赶去远方，梦还没有醒来。天色泛青，第一声鸟鸣落下，城市在昼夜的缝隙中，轻轻换了一口气。","w03":"- Recursion is when solving a big problem means solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Each step makes the problem smaller, like opening smaller boxes nested inside one another.\n- You always need a stopping rule—when you reach the tiniest box, you stop opening and start putting the answers back together."}
